description: This Java class handles the creation of recurring deposit products within the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, delegates the creation logic to a service, and is annotated to specify its command type.

classes.name: CreateRecurringDepositProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to create recurring deposit products by invoking the corresponding write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the creation command for a recurring deposit product by calling the write platform service's create method.
